title: Five goals in nine minutes: Lewandowski against Wolfsburg (22 September 2015)
post:
Bayern were losing 1–0 at home. Pep Guardiola sent on Robert Lewandowski, and nine minutes after his first goal it was 5–1. 22 September 2015: the fastest hat-trick, the fastest four and the fastest five goals in Bundesliga history, all by a substitute.

#lewandowski #bayern #bundesliga #guardiola #football #footballstory #footballtiktok #fcbayern

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"; a quick, rising read: a commentary that cannot keep up

phrases.text: Five goals in nine minutes. Even his own coach couldn't believe it.
phrases.say: [excited] Five goals... in nine minutes. Even his own coach couldn't believe it.

phrases.text: September 2015. Bayern Munich are losing at home to Wolfsburg. 1–0 at half-time.
phrases.say: September twenty fifteen. Bayern Munich are losing at home, to Volfsburg. One–nil at half-time.

phrases.text: So Pep Guardiola sends on a substitute: Robert Lewandowski.
phrases.say: So Pep Guardiola sends on a substitute... Robert Levandovski.

phrases.text: Minute 51. A loose ball in the box. He taps it in.
phrases.say: [intense] Minute fifty-one. A loose ball in the box. He taps it in.

phrases.text: One minute later, from outside the box. 2–1.
phrases.say: One minute later, from outside the box. Two–one!

phrases.text: The third takes three tries: the post, the keeper, the net. A hat-trick in 3 minutes 22 seconds.
phrases.say: The third takes three tries: the post... the keeper... the net! A hat-trick, in three minutes and twenty-two seconds.

phrases.text: Then a cross, a volley, 4–1. And Guardiola is still giving instructions.
phrases.say: Then a cross, a volley, four–one. [amused] And Guardiola is still giving instructions.

phrases.text: Minute 60. Another cross. He meets it in mid-air. Five goals in 8 minutes 59 seconds.
phrases.say: [building] Minute sixty. Another cross. He meets it... in mid-air! [awed] Five goals, in eight minutes and fifty-nine seconds.

phrases.text: On the touchline, Guardiola holds his head in his hands. Later he says: I can't explain it.
phrases.say: On the touchline, Guardiola holds his head in his hands. Later he says: [quietly] I can't explain it.

phrases.text: That night set four Guinness World Records for the Bundesliga: the fastest hat-trick, the fastest four goals, the fastest five, and the most goals by a substitute.
phrases.say: That night set four Guinness World Records for the Bundesliga: the fastest hat-trick, the fastest four goals, the fastest five, and the most goals by a substitute.

phrases.text: And he had started it on the bench.
phrases.say: [softly] And he had started it... on the bench.
